_comment: Shared ground-truth labels for img-test/, used identically by all three benchmark suites. Only 6 images total (3 dermatology, 3 ocular) -- far too few for a meaningful accuracy statistic. This exists for the CROSS-PLATFORM AGREEMENT check (do desktop/mobile/RPi5 agree with each other and with the label on identical input), not as a substitute for the real held-out test-set numbers in dermatho-assets/classification_report.txt and eyediseas-assets/confusion_matrix.png. 'images.jpg' has no reliable label from its filename -- included for agreement-only, never scored.
